Package com.cg.training.model

Class Book

java.lang.Object
com.cg.training.model.Book
public class Book extends Object
Represents a book with a title, author, count, and availability status.

The availability is determined by the count of books in stock.

Author:
Deeptangshu Saha

    • Book

      public Book(String title, String author, int count)
      Constructs a Book with the specified title, author, and initial count. Availability is set based on the count being greater than zero.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      count - the initial number of copies available
